recognize_zh: 肝細胞（圓形核、淡染細胞質）不染色，其間擴張的竇狀隙內充滿 CD25 膜狀強陽性的淋巴細胞聚集，呈竇內（sinusoidal）分布，符合毛細胞白血病侵犯肝臟。
features: Clusters and cords of CD25-positive cells filling dilated hepatic sinusoids
Strong membranous and cytoplasmic CD25 staining of small to medium cells with oval nuclei
Negative hepatocytes with round central nuclei in intervening plates
Sinusoidal/intravascular distribution without portal-based nodules in this field
describe_en: Liver section stained for CD25 shows numerous positive lymphoid cells aggregated within dilated sinusoids between plates of unstained hepatocytes. The positive cells have oval, bland nuclei with moderate cytoplasm and strong membranous staining. The sinusoidal pattern and CD25 expression are consistent with hepatic involvement by hairy cell leukemia.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant (splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukemia with prominent nucleoli)
ddx.vs: Shares sinusoidal red-pulp-type infiltration but is CD25 negative, annexin A1 negative and BRAF V600E wild type.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Also sinusoidal but typically CD25, CD103 and annexin A1 negative.
Sinusoidal infiltrate of CD3+, CD4-/CD8-, usually TCR gamma-delta T cells, not CD20+/CD25+ B cells.
Tends to involve portal tracts in liver and is CD25 usually negative or weak, with absent CD103 and annexin A1.
